verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox infrastructure, not an automation builder. Its closest support for this story is state versioning: you can manage named sandbox snapshots via `e2b sandbox snapshot`, define sandboxes as templates in code, and pause/resume a sandbox to its exact filesystem and memory state, which together allow a rough capture-and-restore workflow. missing for 10: explicit versioning of automations or snapshot history, any review/diff workflow, a documented rollback-to-previous-version operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
